name: Extended remote viewing (ERV) with blinded arms
summary: A long, deep-relaxation session that lets you test, under blinding, whether a state condition changes blind-judged quality. SRI defined extended remote viewing as sessions of over an hour that maximise the sense of the site and minimise awareness of the room. Here a 15-minute induction runs with an optional blinded helmet arm (the first 15 minutes of the Remote viewing program, ring layout) and a descending binaural beat; both arms are our research design. Stimulation stops before you view. There is no evidence that any sound or magnetic program improves remote viewing.
setting: Reclined in a dark, quiet room, with headphones and the phone within reach for writing and sketching. If you use the helmet, fit it in the ring layout (see Placement): the Remote viewing program rotates around the head and plays on the wrong sites in the temporal fit. A blind interviewer on a headset is optional.
cautions: Coil clicks, warmth or tingling can give away the real condition; the blinding check tells you whether blinding held. Long sessions are tiring (in 1976 Pat Price tired after 15 minutes). The CRV manual's own theory counts low-frequency fields as a possible inclemency. Stop on headache or distress. The 1995 AIR evaluation found a statistically significant laboratory effect that could not be clearly attributed to psi, and no operational value. Never use people as targets without their consent. One trial means little: with a realistic effect size (about 0.16) even 50 trials have only about 30 % power. Decide the number of trials in advance and keep every result. The helmet arm runs together with the binaural beat, and the god-helmet.com Shakti safety page advises against combining the helmet with binaural-beat devices in real time: that combination is exactly what the blinded arms test, so leave the helmet off if you prefer to follow the advice.

sources.title: Targ R, Puthoff HE, Humphrey BS, May EC (1980) Special Orientation Techniques (SRI R-003-80), SRI International
Puthoff HE, Targ R (1976) A perceptual channel for information transfer over kilometer distances. Proc IEEE 64:329-354
McMoneagle J (1993) Mind Trek. Hampton Roads
Smith PH (1986) Coordinate Remote Viewing manual, DIA/INSCOM, after Ingo Swann's SRI training (widely posted; Swann did not write it)

steps.title: Blind target
steps.instructions: The helmet picks a target picture and commits to it. The trial number is your tag.

steps.title: Helmet (optional)
steps.instructions: If you use the helmet, put it on now in the **ring layout** (see the Placement tab), not the temporal fit. It runs blinded during the induction only, real or sham. Without the helmet, press Next.

steps.title: Induction
steps.instructions:
Lights off. Lie back and close your eyes. Let after-images fade and your thoughts slow down. Nothing to do yet.

*Sound (our design): pink noise and a beat on 200 Hz descending from 10 to 6 Hz. In sham mode the same tones play with no beat.*

steps.title: Extended viewing
steps.instructions: Describe the impressions that come to mind about the target, slowly and in detail. Give yourself time; the aim is to be more at the site than in the room. Short pauses are fine. You may shift your viewpoint, for example to above the scene.

steps.title: Summary
steps.instructions: Sum up the session in a few plain sentences.

steps.title: Lock your response
steps.instructions: Lock your response. The app stores its fingerprint (SHA-256), so nothing can be changed after you see the target.

steps.title: Your state
steps.instructions: Before any feedback, describe your state during the session.

steps.title: Blinding check
steps.instructions: Guess whether the helmet field and the beat were real or sham.

steps.title: Rank the pictures
steps.instructions: You now see all pictures of the drawn set in random order. Rank them, best match with your response first. Judge by what you wrote and drew. If someone who doesn't know the target can judge, hand them the phone now; otherwise the trial counts as self-judged. Never re-judge after the reveal.

steps.title: Reveal
steps.instructions: The helmet reveals the target and its nonce, and the app checks the commitment, the pool and your locked response. A rank-1 hit has a chance of 1 in the number of pictures in the set.
